title: sparc-shells-relaxed: Relaxed-Cap Shell Catalog with Constrained-Run Validation and Multi-Body Decomposition under DGC Scaling
description:
Analysis code, derived catalogs, and methodology validation outputs for Paper III of the SPARC shells series. Extends the Paper I methodology (Bibb 2026, PASP-102415) by:

  • Relaxing the shell-width cap (σ/r) from 0.4 to 0.8 to address pegging in the strict-cap fits
  • Increasing the maximum shell count from 2 to 5
  • Adding hierarchical mass-to-light (Υ) marginalization to address the Paper I referee critique on NGC 5055 BIC behavior
  • Producing a constrained-during-fit companion catalog (DGC + Hill + 1% M_central) for interpretation-strength comparison
  • Reporting implied IMBH populations under DGC scaling as bookkeeping (one possible interpretation, presented with explicit caveats; the catalog does not claim DGC applies at sub-halo scales)
  • Categorizing shells by DGC compatibility (Tier A: n_BH ≤ 2 acceptable; Tier B/C: DGC-overbudget)
  • Cross-tracer validation work using Walton+ 2022 ULX positions, THINGS HI moment maps, and an NGC 5055 Chandra cross-match (scripts shared with the companion Paper IV repository)

The repository includes the primary 123-galaxy relaxed-cap catalog with multi-body decomposition columns, an earlier 102-galaxy n≤2 run for backward compatibility with Paper I, the Paper I strict-cap catalog for reference, the DGC + Hill + M_central constrained-during-fit run, and a per-galaxy strict↔relaxed classification (91 stable_adequate, 6 rescued, 5 still_failing of 102 baseline galaxies).

Status at v0.1.0: pre-writing snapshot for priority-stamping. Empirical work and methodology validation substantially complete; manuscript drafting pending.
